text:
Elena Martinez: hey y'all, first day and running into two access hiccups. can anyone point me to the right owner? :wave:
Elena Martinez: (1) GCP - I can't see the billing account to attach project 'redwood-explorers' (console says "You need permission to view billing accounts").
Elena Martinez: (2) AWS - after SSO I only show a user session, not the assumed role 'Redwood-Developer', so I can't create ECR repos (AccessDenied).
Elena Martinez: I filed the onboarding checklist but wanted a shorter path if possible. cc @Omar Ali
Omar Ali: welcome Elena! for AWS that's usually an SSO assignment issue. Which SSO link did you use? did you follow https://sso.redwood.com/ and select the "Redwood-Developer" application?
Elena Martinez: yep I used the link, but the console still shows my username and not the assumed-role ARN.
Omar Ali: try signing out of the AWS console and re-launching from SSO, or use the CLI SSO flow `aws sso login --profile redwood`. sometimes the session cookie sticks to the user identity.
Elena Martinez: `aws sts get-caller-identity` returns my user ARN, redoing SSO now.
SSO Bot: Reminder: if SSO assignment isn't visible, re-run the SSO provisioning job or contact identity@redwood.com.
Elena Martinez: re-run worked - now I see arn:aws:sts::444555666777:assumed-role/Redwood-Developer/Elena. trying ECR create again.
Elena Martinez: ECR repo create succeeded, thanks Omar!
billing-ops: for GCP billing visibility, we need either billing.viewer on the billing account or project/billing.admin on the project to attach. The fastest route: file a billing link request at https://access.redwood.com (choose "GCP Billing") and include the project id and billing account id if you know it. If you ping this thread with the ticket id I can expedite approval.
Elena Martinez: filed ticket INC-10234 with project redwood-explorers, left billing id blank and added my manager for approval.
billing-ops: got it. I'll watch INC-10234 and approve as soon as finance signs off. once linked you may need to logout of the console or `gcloud auth login` again to see billing info.
Elena Martinez: thanks! quick note for others: if you see AccessDenied for region-scoped resources, check your default region in the CLI/profile. that bit me earlier with ECR in us-west-2 vs my default us-east-1.
onboarding-bot: Friendly reminder: finish the cloud onboarding checklist to avoid delays: https://onboarding.redwood.com/checklist
Elena Martinez: all set for now - AWS role fixed, billing request submitted. appreciate the quick help :pray:
